decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template was publicly recommended, fits the shop-hosting core, and costs little to maintain, though it has not been visible since 2018 and its sibling template was already dropped.
Premium support embodies the announced agency-focused, round-the-clock expert service strategy, so it is central and strongly committed.
The version management tool carries sunk in-house development investment and had a page of its own, so management persists despite its lower visibility since 2018.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship shown on the home page and central to the firm's announced direction, so commitment to it is highest.
